content: china criticises anthropic's chief for the united states to curb its AI . he calls for continued restrictions on the sale of cutting-edge AI chips and chipmaking equipment to China . foreign ministry spokesperson says all parties should work together to advance artificial intelligence .

title: Pakistan lists JeM chief Masood Azhar as fugitive, raises bounty ahead of FATF review
content: PKR 50 lakh bounty raised on 'fugitive' jaish-e-Mohammed chief Masood Azhar . comes ahead of the financial action task force plenary scheduled for October . faa has increased the reward for information leading to most-wanted terrorist .

title: China's spy chief flags AI threat, warns of 'cognitive warfare' & threats to security
content: china's ministry of state security issued its first public warning on the national security risks posed by artificial intelligence . foreign actors were exploiting emerging AI tools to conduct what he described as public opinion and cognitive warfare against China . he accuses hostile forces of using generative AI to spread political rumours and manipulate public opinion .

title: Crucial lifeline: India to supply 654MW of power daily to flood-ravaged Nepal
content: up to 654 MW of electricity will be exported to Nepal for 18 hours a day . up to 600 MW will be supplied through the muzaffarpur-Dhalkebar 400 kV double-circuit line . another 54 MW can be transmitted through the Tanakpur-Mahendranagar 132 kv single-circ line, the ministry of power says .

title: More than a summer home: A look inside the Kennedys' historic Hyannis Port estate
content: the family’s sprawling compound in Hyannis Port, Massachusetts, has been more than a summer retreat . the property has hosted generations of Kennedys, witnessed key moments in American political history and offered the family a private place to celebrate, compete and grieve .

title: South Africa road crash involving multiple vehicles kills 21
content: at least 21 people were killed in a multi-vehicle crash in western Cape province . the crash involved two minibus taxis and an SUV on the N1 highway . three victims were taken to a hospital but were declared dead on arrival .

title: Maharashtra govt aims to table UCC Bill in assembly winter session: CM Fadnavis
content: the government plans to table its uniform civil code bill during assembly winter session . chief minister devendra Fadnavis says the government will move ahead with the proposed legislation once the panel submits its report . the committee headed by retired Supreme Court judge justice Ranjana Desai is working on the framework for the proposed code .

title: 'Someone from that ward voted for me': BJP candidate gets 1 vote in Rajasthan
content: BJP candidate Kailashchand contested from ward 13 of the Parbatsar municipality in Didwana-Kuchaman district . he says he received only one vote from the ward that he contested . the state election commission website says the results show he was a voter in ward 12 .

title: CIA deception op, over 90 troops: How US rescued 'Alpha & Bravo' from Iran - video
content: x.com/60Minutes declassified video of the rescue video credit: x .com . more than 90 service members were deployed on the ground during the rescue operation . hundreds of personnel were involved in the air and several thousand others provided support, according to '60 Minutes'

title: Aaditya Thackeray, Rhea Chakraborty named in Disha death case: Key details from CBI FIR
content: the central bureau of investigation (CBI) on Monday registered an FIR in connection with the death of disha Salian . the former manager of late actor sushant Singh Rajput died following an order of the high court . it names several individuals whose roles have been listed for investigation .

title: 17 NCPI MPs to join BJP soon: Rebel TMC MP's big 'Durga Puja' claim
content: rebel TMC leader says 17 of the 20 MPs are likely to join the ruling Bhartiya Janata Party . the move comes nearly three months after 20 dissident TMC MPs announced their merger with the little-known nationalist Citizens Party of India on June 14 .
